First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: green (beginner, no-drop), blue (intermediate, no-drop), black (advanced, may drop). It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the OUTspokin' Club Rides group ride

Colorado's LGBTQ+ cycling club, riding road and gravel around greater Denver. Rides are graded green, blue and black; green and blue are no-drop. Allies welcome. Sign a waiver and try one ride free before joining.
